slots.hair: a French bun being taken down, pins still in it
slots.outfit: a navy uniform pencil skirt and white shirt with the scarf already untied and lying on the bed, the top two buttons open
slots.place: sitting on the edge of the bed in a hotel room she has just landed into, the curtains already pulled open on a city she does not live in
slots.action: She has both hands up taking the French bun apart with a pin still held between her lips.
slots.face: No expression because of the pin in her lips, her eyes on the lens with the tiredness of just landing.
slots.light: One warm bedside lamp is in front of her, the city outside the window stays cold, and the depth of the room is dark.

slots.hair: all the way down in loose waves
slots.outfit: a white silk slip with thin straps
slots.place: curled into the single armchair by the floor-to-ceiling window of her own apartment in Singapore, on one of the days she is home
slots.action: She is tucked into the chair lighting the candle she carries in her luggage with one hand.
slots.face: Not a trace of makeup and a very loose expression, not smiling.
slots.light: The candle and one floor lamp are both in front of her and low, and the night outside the window is dark.

slots.hair: loose and spread over her shoulders
slots.outfit: a cool grey silk pyjama top with the neckline slipped to one side
slots.place: lying across the bed in her Singapore apartment at three in the morning, still awake with the time zones wrong
slots.action: She is lying on her front propped up on her elbows with her hair down over her shoulders.
slots.face: The particular alertness of not being able to sleep, her eyes on the lens.
slots.light: The bedside lamp is in front of her and low and the rest of the room is completely dark.

slots.hair: gathered into one length and brought forward over one shoulder
slots.outfit: a gold silk robe tied loosely
slots.place: in the bathroom of her Singapore apartment, only a bottle of cleanser and that same candle on the counter
slots.action: Her free hand is gathering her hair into a rope and bringing it forward over her shoulder.
slots.light: The lamp above the mirror is directly in front of her and the depth of the bathroom is dark.

slots.outfit: the complete navy cabin-crew uniform with the scarf tied properly
slots.place: at the mouth of an airbridge at Changi in the early morning, an aircraft parked outside the glass
slots.action: She has stopped by the window pulling her cabin bag, one hand still on the handle.
slots.face: The professional warmth, the switch already flipped on.
slots.light: The cold white lights at the airbridge are in front of her and the apron outside is still dark.
